items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: the only thing that saved me is Jimmy Ryan. I woke up Jimmy Ryan and he woke up and came and came down there and identified me.

ctx.x: Now, you can believe these cops, how they bought my story. When they saw the size of the writeup, and they looked at me out of the side of their eye, and the only thing that saved me is Jimmy Ryan. I woke up Jimmy Ryan and he woke up and came and came down there and identified me. And they still figured I ought to get locked up.
But they let me go. They believed me then that I hadn't seen anything. And I never saw the guy, I don't know what he looked like. But this was one of my first writeups.
